text_block_list.text:
Today, Смарт Фалкон and I begin our
challenge of
competing in the Twinkle
Series at last.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's a stunningly fine day, perfect for new

beginnings. I take my time getting ready
and am
about to head out, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ding dong!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ding dong! Ding dong! Ding dong!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! ☆ Don't tell me you forgot
the chant!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Smart and stunning no matter how fast
she
flies! ☆ It's everyone's
favorite—Faaalco! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We're starting training today, aren't we?
I was so
excited, I couldn't sit still! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Let's go already, Trainer! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
There's only one place for an Umadol to
go! And
that is...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Good morning! ☆ Good morning!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
My Umadol performance is about to
begin! How
about a shot of Umadol
energy to start your day
off on the right
foot? ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон has led me down to the
river, where
it appears she performs
daily.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What's an... "Umadol"?
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text: Beats me...
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text: That's a fantastic question!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Passersby

text_block_list.text: An Umadol is a brand-new type of idol! A dazzlingly brilliant Umamusume who shines brightly on the stage and the racecourse! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I sing here every day 'cause I'm aiming to
be a top
Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: O-oh, I see...
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
Stick around and listen if you can! The
best seats
in the house are yours for the
taking—
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Squeee! ♪
Wh-what was that?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Водка, go away! You're attracting too
much
attention!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Huhhh?! Why don't you go away? I'm just getting some coffee!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Don't try and act all cool! You can't
even drink
coffee!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Wh-whaaat?! O-of course I can! In fact, I
even
drink it black!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! Дайва Скарлет and Водка
are
bickering again!
Awww, they're so
cute! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear that? Водка and
Дайва Скарлет
are having one of their
famous fights! Let's check
it out!
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text: Hey! W-wait, don't leave!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
No way... ☆ Their argument attracted
more
attention than my performance...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I remind her that Дайва Скарлет and
Водка are
two of the favorites to do
well in the Classics this
year. It's
inevitable that they draw attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The Classics... G1 races, all on turf...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's all the more reason why I can't
lose!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We're continuing the performance! Even
if
nobody listens...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I just know that my song will reach their
hearts! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Lalalaaa! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The sight of her singing all alone
reminds me of
when I first met her.
Singing her heart out as if to
yell "look
at me!"
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: She looked as if she was shining.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Nobody showed up today either...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Honestly, a little disappointed... But it's
no
biggie!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm actually feeling motivated! An
Umadol shines
brightest under pressure!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And the more hurdles I have to clear,
the brighter
I'll shine!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And besides—there's no way I can let
myself get
down at this stage! Not when
I remember my
dream!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: To become dirt racing's top Umadol!

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll start by making dirt races the
greatest in
the world!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The Classics, the Arima Kinen, the Japan
Cup, the
Tenno Sho... All the biggest
races are held on
turf.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The raw power on display in dirt races
still draws
many fans, but to a much
lesser extent. Out of all
the central G1
races, only two are on dirt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It won't be easy to outshine all the turf
runners
and become a top Umadol
through dirt racing
alone.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But I'm already committed! I'm gonna
keep my
eyes on the road ahead and run
till I reach the
top! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Plus, my first fan will always be here by
my side,
right? ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Just as we're reaffirming Смарт Фалкон's
dream of
becoming a top Umadol
through dirt racing...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wait, is the performance over?
text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails

text_block_list.text: Hm? Are you...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You're the one who always sings here,
right? I'm
always cheering for you!
text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I had some time today, so I came to
watch you!
But... are you already done?
text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails

text_block_list.text: T-Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: There's still time for an encore, don't you think?

text_block_list.text: There sure is! ☆ We're not done yet! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Let's sing one more song! This one goes
out to
you, my special fan! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So begins Смарт Фалкон's dream of
becoming a
top Umadol—a dream which
may one day become
legend.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
